title: feat(ai): record the Anthropic web search count in the LangChain callback handler

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+pypi/posthog: patch
+---
+
+The LangChain callback handler now records `$ai_web_search_count` for Anthropic responses that report `server_tool_use.web_search_requests`, as the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini wrappers and `posthog-js` already do.

@@ -838,6 +840,23 @@ class ModelUsage:
     reasoning_tokens: Optional[int]
     cache_write_5m_tokens: Optional[int] = None
     cache_write_1h_tokens: Optional[int] = None
+    web_search_count: Optional[int] = None
+
+
+def _extract_web_search_requests(usage: Union[BaseModel, dict]) -> Optional[int]:
+    if isinstance(usage, BaseModel):
+        usage = usage.__dict__
+    server_tool_use = usage.get("server_tool_use")
+    web_search_requests = (
+        server_tool_use.get("web_search_requests")
+        if isinstance(server_tool_use, dict)
+        else getattr(server_tool_use, "web_search_requests", None)
+    )
+    if isinstance(web_search_requests, int) and not isinstance(
+        web_search_requests, bool
+    ):
+        return web_search_requests
+    return None

@@ -2955,6 +2955,57 @@ def test_stop_reason_resolution(
     assert props.get("$ai_stop_reason") == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "server_tool_use,expected",
+    [
+        # Anthropic reports the exact number of searches
+        ({"web_search_requests": 2}, 2),
+        # no search is not worth an event property
+        ({"web_search_requests": 0}, None),
+        # the provider reports nothing
+        (None, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_web_search_count(mock_client, server_tool_use, expected):
+    from langchain_core.outputs import ChatGeneration, LLMResult
+
+    cb = CallbackHandler(mock_client)
+    run_id = uuid.uuid4()
+    cb._set_llm_metadata(
+        serialized={},
+        run_id=run_id,
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "test"}],
+        metadata={"ls_provider": "anthropic", "ls_model_name": "claude-sonnet"},
+    )
+    usage = {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 5}
+    if server_tool_use is not None:
+        usage["server_tool_use"] = server_tool_use
+    # langchain-anthropic always sets usage_metadata on the message, which the
+    # generations loop prefers over llm_output["usage"]
+    response = LLMResult(
+        generations=[
+            [
+                ChatGeneration(
+                    message=AIMessage(
+                        content="r",
+                        usage_metadata={
+                            "input_tokens": 10,
+                            "output_tokens": 5,
+                            "total_tokens": 15,
+                        },
+                    )
+                )
+            ]
+        ],
+        llm_output={"usage": usage},
+    )
+
+    cb._pop_run_and_capture_generation(run_id, None, response)
+
+    props = mock_client.capture.call_args.kwargs["properties"]
+    assert props.get("$ai_web_search_count") == expected
+
